_comment: Domain-solution reference registry. Each domain maps to a list of named solution types. 'triggers' are column-name / value keywords that signal this solution. Edit freely — loaded at runtime by domain_detector.py.

Healthcare.name: Mortality Prediction
Healthcare.description: Predict which patients are at risk of dying within a care episode or defined time window.

Healthcare.name: Readmission Prediction
Healthcare.description: Identify patients likely to be readmitted to hospital within 30/60/90 days of discharge.

Healthcare.name: Length of Stay Modeling
Healthcare.description: Predict or analyse patient length of stay to support capacity planning and care pathway optimisation.

Healthcare.name: Clinical Risk Stratification
Healthcare.description: Score and tier patients by overall clinical risk across multiple conditions or episodes.

Healthcare.name: Claim Denial Management
Healthcare.description: Identify claims likely to be denied and surface root causes to reduce denial rate.

Healthcare.name: Care Pathway Analysis
Healthcare.description: Map and optimise clinical care pathways by analysing episode sequences and outcomes.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Membership Churn Prediction
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Predict which GPO members are at risk of terminating membership within a defined time horizon.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Contract Penetration Analysis
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Measure and improve member purchasing compliance and contract utilisation by segment.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Member Segmentation
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Segment GPO members by class of trade, purchasing behaviour, or engagement to personalise outreach.

Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.name: Network Growth Analysis
Healthcare Supply Chain / GPO.description: Analyse member acquisition and retention trends to forecast GPO network size and composition.

Pharmaceutical.name: Clinical Trial Outcome Analysis
Pharmaceutical.description: Analyse efficacy, safety, and dropout patterns across trial phases.

Pharmaceutical.name: Adverse Event Detection
Pharmaceutical.description: Flag and characterise adverse drug reactions from trial or real-world data.

Pharmaceutical.name: Compound Screening
Pharmaceutical.description: Score or rank drug candidates by predicted efficacy or safety profile.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Credit Risk Scoring
Financial Services / Lending.description: Score loan applicants or existing borrowers by probability of default or delinquency.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Fraud Detection
Financial Services / Lending.description: Identify fraudulent transactions or applications in real time or batch.

Financial Services / Lending.name: Portfolio Analytics
Financial Services / Lending.description: Monitor and report on loan portfolio quality, concentration, and performance trends.

Insurance.name: Claims Analytics
Insurance.description: Analyse claim frequency, severity, and loss ratio to inform pricing and reserving.

Insurance.name: Fraud Detection
Insurance.description: Score claims for suspected fraud or abuse before payment.

Insurance.name: Premium Optimisation
Insurance.description: Model risk factors to price premiums more accurately by segment.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Customer Churn Prediction
Retail & E-commerce.description: Identify customers at risk of lapsing or reducing purchasing activity.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Demand Forecasting
Retail & E-commerce.description: Forecast product demand by SKU, category, or location to inform inventory planning.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Recommendation Engine
Retail & E-commerce.description: Personalise product recommendations based on purchase history and browsing behaviour.

Retail & E-commerce.name: Pricing & Promotions Analysis
Retail & E-commerce.description: Measure price elasticity and promotion effectiveness to optimise margin.

HR & People Analytics.name: Attrition Prediction
HR & People Analytics.description: Identify employees at risk of leaving to support retention planning.

HR & People Analytics.name: Compensation Analysis
HR & People Analytics.description: Audit pay equity and model compensation structures across levels and demographics.

HR & People Analytics.name: Workforce Planning
HR & People Analytics.description: Model headcount needs, hiring pipeline, and span-of-control targets.

Education.name: At-Risk Student Identification
Education.description: Flag students at risk of dropping out or failing based on attendance and performance signals.

Education.name: Course Effectiveness Analysis
Education.description: Measure the impact of courses, instructors, and interventions on student outcomes.

Industrial Equipment.name: Predictive Maintenance
Industrial Equipment.description: Predict equipment failure or maintenance needs before they cause downtime.

Industrial Equipment.name: Asset Performance Management
Industrial Equipment.description: Track OEE, MTBF, and MTTR to optimise asset utilisation and reliability.

Industrial Equipment.name: Product Data Quality
Industrial Equipment.description: Assess and remediate completeness, consistency, and accuracy of equipment specifications.

General.name: Exploratory Data Analysis
General.description: Profile, summarise, and surface patterns in an unfamiliar dataset.
